interpretation: This is a current aggregate geography/program snapshot. Referral, eligibility, and assistance categories are not a person-level longitudinal denominator; records may represent different program stages and the category populations should not be added as unique survivors.
missingness: later housing, work, health, trust, action, or recovery
boundary: The snapshot advances current registration-to-referral-to-eligibility visibility for one disaster. It does not estimate approval fairness, take-up, payment receipt, repair completion, housing stability, or survivor recovery.
